name: San Marino

observations.reasoning: Sourced on 2026-07-27, closing the one gap the population pass had left. 34172 resident inhabitants on 1 January 2026, recorded as 0.034 million. Read in the Bollettino di Statistica, I trimestre 2026, published by the Ufficio Informatica, Tecnologia, Dati e Statistica, Tavola 1.1, Bilancio Demografico (movimento della popolazione residente), row Popolazione Residente ad inizio periodo, column Gen 2026. The earlier attempt reported the figure as unreachable and that was accurate about the route, not the document: statistica.sm's front page is a navigation hub, and the number sits in the quarterly bulletin, a PDF two levels down. The bulletin was found through the site's own publications page and opened. Two choices are recorded because the document permits others. First, the reference date: the bulletin also gives 34154 residents at 31 March 2026, which is fresher, but 1 January is the stock convention the forty-one Eurostat countries use, and a third reference date for one country would cost more than three months of freshness are worth. Second, the concept: the bulletin distinguishes popolazione residente, those registered as resident, from popolazione presente, which adds soggiornanti staying in the territory and reaches 35589. The resident figure is the one recorded, being the concept Eurostat's demo_pjan uses. The previous 0.03 was an opening estimate made with no source.

Searched on 2026-07-27, in Italian, as part of the transversal venues pass over the smallest countries. Zero. The Republic's theatres are run by the Istituti Culturali, Sezione Arti Performative, and their own page names all three: the Teatro Titano in the historic centre, an Italian-style house of about 315 seats; the Teatro Nuovo at Dogana; and the Cinema Teatro Concordia at Borgo Maggiore, 402 seats, back in service since 1997. None is a puppet theatre and none is said to host a permanent puppetry company. The season the section programmes is prose, research, dance, music and poetry. The denominator asks for a permanent puppetry unit with a venue of its own and public backing: the venues exist and are public, the puppetry unit does not. The previous value was the same zero, produced with no research.

Web check of 2026-07-27. No establishment retained. San Marino has a single higher education institution, the University of the Republic of San Marino, with no drama faculty or higher arts school. In the absence of any higher arts education in the country, no specialised higher training in puppetry arts can exist. Upper bound held at 0 for that reason. Estimate: the argument rests on the size of the higher education system, not on a source read.

DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
Opening estimate, produced with no source and no research. It exists to be falsified, not to be used as data.
